releases.displayName: Metaball New Year Update Adds Story Mode, Ranked Play, New Maps and More!

notes.title: Gear up for the ultimate hoverboard basketball experience with Metaball's massive New Year update, live now! Packed with exciting new features

items.text: 🎥 Watch the official New Year trailer .
Master Your Skills with the Enhanced Academy

The Metaball Academy has been redesigned to help you up your game. Introducing an improved lesson system now with step-by-step tutorials aimed at making players better. With guided training paths, the Academy will have you dominating the court in no time.
Dominate the Court in Story Mode
Take on rivals in the all-new Story Mode, a challenging solo experience where you rise to the top through missions and intense matches.
Rise Through the Ranks in Ranked Mode
Competitive players, rejoice! Ranked Mode brings a ladder system that will let you rank through divisions, gain seasonal rewards, access a special shop, and show your skills to the world.
Will you be the #1?
Exciting New Maps

Get ready for the most intense competition on the stunning courts in our New Year Update, from high-stakes 1v1 battles to strategic 2v2 showdowns. These arenas offer fresh and dynamic gameplay on every map.
Unlock Exclusive Rewards with the New Metapass

The new season's pass is here, and with it, a whole slew of exclusive items and cosmetics to make your Metaball experience even better. Complete challenges, level up your Metapass and show off your rewards on the court. The grind has never felt this good!
Don't Miss Out on a Free Limited-Time Legendary Outfit

Show off your style with our FREE Limited-Time Legendary Outfit! Collect exclusive parts through daily missions from January 24th, 2025 to February 28, 2025. Whether in Ranked Mode or Quick matches, show off this special reward before it's gone forever.
Join the Action Today!
Download Metaball for free and get started. Whether you're gunning for glory in Ranked Mode, diving deep into Story Mode, or just showing off your style, there's never been a better time to play.
Connect with fellow Riders, share your epic plays, and stay updated on all the latest Metaball news on our official Discord and social media channels.

All goals are worth 1 point.
Each team has 1 attack/defense turn per set.
A successful attack is scoring a point within the attack time limit.
A successful defense is to prevent a goal within the attack time limit.
If the losing team cannot tie or win the game even if they win all their attacks in the remaining sets, the game ends immediately (mercy rule).
The first team to attack is determined by a coin toss (random).

Fixed a bug where Harvester Arena could be selected in Private Matches. Harvester Arena is a tournament-only map (Tournament mode is again delayed).
Fixed a bug where changing the Grab and Shield keybindings in Parameters would not change in-game.
Fixed a bug where the new Multi Grab Perk icon would not appear.
Fixed a bug where hitting the target in a Pass Challenge would not be recognized.
Fixed a bug where scores would display incorrectly when going over 99 and into the 100s.
Fixed a bug where languages and dubs were not initialized when initializing gameplay options
Fixed a bug where the minimap UI would remain visible when turned off in-game options.
Changed the basic mechanics of Shields: Shields can no longer be activated while in the red gauge.
The Academy "Swing Dunk", "Swing Shot", and "Side Swing" stages have been modified for new players to understand them better.
Fixed a bug where the Play button was inactive even when not already searching for a match.
Fixed a bug where the Multi Grab Perk would not appear on the in-game scoreboard.
Fixed a bug where rechargeable Grabs would incorrectly reset their cooldown.
Fixed a bug that prevented Party Play in the same region.
Fixed a bug where adding friends would not work correctly.
Fixed a bug where user rankings were not displaying correctly in the Ranking Menu.
Fixed a bug where a grayed-out background would remain when the Minimap display setting was turned off.
Fixed a bug where the "Tilt(midair) Deadzone" option was not working properly and had duplicate names.
Fixed a bug that caused scores to display incorrectly when scores were over 99 and into the 100s.
Changed the basic mechanics for Shields: Shields are no longer unlimited and instead have a gauge.
Changed the ruling on own goals so that if an opponent touches a 3-pointer just before it is scored, it is no longer awarded as 2 points.
Reduced the size of the ball generator as it was deemed to be obstructive to the view when playing the game.
The maximum angle for tilt-pitch is also now configurable in the parameters.
Changed the design of the in-game UI.
Fixed Perks: *Defense last Perks: changed to Charged Grab: *Defense 2nd Perks: changed to Increased Shield Power: *Balance 1st Perks: changed to Increased Invulnerability Time on Ball Grab
Fixed a bug where Grab cooldowns would not reset if you used a Grab in practice area just before a match starts.
Fixed a bug where the ball generator would not spawn balls.
Fixed a bug where the character would automatically rotate when the ball was taken away.
You can now see your username on the Quick Match team intro screen.
Changed the criteria by which the character rotates when steering in the air.
Added 6 more steps to the Guided Quest, totaling 10 steps.
Added option to change the maximum angle for Left and Right Tilt.
Added option to change the rotation start speed value for Forward and Backward Tilt.
Added the option to change the rotation start speed value for Left and Right Tilt.
Added the ability to change maximum speed, acceleration, nitro recovery, and goal height in Private Match settings.
Fixed a bug that caused the ball to go off the map.
Fixed a bug where you could not start a game if you were the party leader on PS and joined a party with another platform user.
Reduced the range that characters (other than the character who collided with the ball) could be knocked back when in Power Swing or Shielded.
Fixed a bug where the quest completion notification would continue to appear after completing step 10 of the Seasonal Quest.
Fixed a bug where flipping through subcategories in a locker would take you to accessories.
The Basic Tutorial is gone and Academy Mode is here.
In Academy mode, you'll learn Layups, Dash Passes, Saves, and Side Swing Passes in addition to the maneuvers taught in the Basic Tutorial.
You'll need to play Basic AI Match, which is Academy level 6, before you can access Quick Matches and Private Matches.
We've reduced the window of time a user can join a Quick Match to reduce the likelihood of a user joining a match that is already heavily gapped.
The Basic Tutorial was deemed too difficult for new players, so we've lowered its difficulty.
Guide Quests were deemed too difficult for new players, so we've lowered their difficulty.
Added a feature that recommends users who are not yet your friends.
Added a quick chat feature in the lobby.
Added 3 new skin colors... (black, red, yellow)
Added a shortcut link to the lobby announcement banner.
Added an event banner for Christmas gifts in the lobby.

We've added the ability to praise teammates you've played with on the game results screen. You can only compliment the same user once per hour. When you receive a compliment, your Honor level increases. You will receive rewards based on your Honor level.
We've nerfed the Dash Stun Perk because we feel it's too OP, and now you won't lose the ball you're holding when you get Dash stunned.
Reduced the difficulty of the Basic Tutorial.
We've added the ability to import your friend's customizations and perks as a bot. You can add this bot to your party at any time, regardless of whether they are actually playing to Metaball or not.
After a game ends, the teammates you last played with will appear in the lobby. You can choose to add them as friends or party with them.
We have expanded the range of matchmaking research with a limit to not cause discomfort to the game. You can now play Quick Match with a wider variety of people.
We've added a new UI for creating parties, leaving parties, and kicking out party members. You can now select the party menu in the lobby more easily.
At the end of the basic tutorial, we added an effect that plays when you score in 2v2.
Added basic controls list to the control guide inside the menu (Xbox controllers will be added later).
Slightly increased the rebound force when the ball collides with the backboard.
Increased the thickness of the goal to address a bug with the goal.
Increased the power of the Side Swing release.
Fixed a bug where there was no sound when triggering a power swing.
Reduced the size of the hitbox between the backboard and rim.
Added a tutorial to learn the double jump in the Basic tutorial.
You can now see your friends' perks and history in the party invitation window. In the future, we'll add the ability to see their outfits as well.
Added a Controls Guide to the ESC menu that summarizes the controls and skills available in Metaball. In the future, we'll add Advanced Techniques and Configuration.
Fixed a bug where you were considered mid-air when dashing or moving on a side wall.
We've been working on overall physics balance (this includes Tilt speed, character speed, irregular bounce, irregular spin, etc.).
Fixed a bug where the ball would strangely bounce off the floor when performing a Side Swing pass.
We felt that the tutorial could be difficult for new players, so we lowered the difficulty level.
In private matches, we changed the functionality of changing teams, becoming a spectator, etc. to be managed directly by the lobby owner.
Fixed a bug that caused the ball to bounce irregularly when releasing with a Power Swing.
Slightly reduced the air resistance to the ball when releasing with a power swing.
We worked on balancing the overall physics.
Removed and fixed sounds when landing on the board or while titlting.
Fixed a bug where the AI would not shoot correctly.
We've applied the same air resistance and floor friction to Power Swing Shots as we did to Swing Shots.
We've made a lot of changes to the basic tutorial to make it easier for new players to learn the game.
We realized that keeping the ball on the sidewalls could potentially make the game boring, so we removed the ability to climb and stay on the sidewalls for long periods of time.
We increased the base speed slightly.
We found a number of matchmaking bugs and made changes to the matchmaking system to make quick matches smoother.
You can now freely move around the lobby while waiting for a match.
When playing Quick Match in a party, we found a number of bugs and made changes to the party system to make party matching smoother.
We performed optimizations for very low, low, medium, and high graphics option.
We fixed a bug where the red and blue teams were not displayed correctly when you were a spectator in a private match.
We've lowered the brightness of the lobby background because we've gotten feedback that it was too bright and was causing eye strain.
Changed the font throughout the game, as it was causing the game to freeze or take a long time to load when changing to a different language in Options.
1) Gameplay changes
We've added a Grab training in the Basic Tutorial to make new users more aware of grabbing techniques.
2) Changes based on feedback
Fixed a bug where users could be split into different matches in the same Private Match room.
Fixed a bug in the Win a Quick Match quest that would count even if you lost.

topNew: We've added a Grab training in the Basic Tutorial to make new users more aware of grabbing techniques.

items.text: 1) Gameplay changes
We've changed the in-game TAB screen to show the Final Perk equipped by all users in the game.
Users who don't have a Final Perk equipped will be shown as a blank space.
2) Change for feedback
Fixed a bug that caused infinite loading during the queue for matchmaking.
Fixed a bug where animations were not working properly in-game.

topNew: We've changed the in-game TAB screen to show the Final Perk equipped by all users in the game.
Users who don't have a Final Perk equipped will be shown as a blank space.

items.text: Due to system changes on the old server, we have reset all user data such as items, quests, etc. to the new server.
Added spectator mode to private matches.
Added a preset for locker items. They're called Style Slots.
Added the ability to swap Perks in free play.
Added Korean and French dubbing in the tutorial and in-game. Other languages will be added in the future.
Made a small fix to the real-time MVP Points UI that was displayed during regular matches.
Slightly increased the time for before the ball regenerates after scoring a goal in regular matches (2 seconds > 3 seconds).
When playing a regular match, the UI that appears when a goal is scored (scorer's name and text such as pass, rebound, block, etc.) has been reduced in size.
When the bot has the ball, you can now use quick chat [Over here!] and the bot will pass to you.
You can now press and hold the movement arrow keys to navigate in the menus with a controller or keyboard.
Replaced the Metaball ID with a Meta Tag format. Each user gets a unique 6-digit Meta Tag.

We've added Japanese, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), German, Italian, Polish, Portuguese, and Russian to our list of supported languages, which previously included Korean, English, French, and Spanish.
Due to issues with Quests and the Meta Pass, we had to move to a new server, so we decided to reset user data.
10 Beam Drops will be provided as compensation for resetting.
We slightly reduced the ball's bounce.
Modified the AI's logic to make their movements and judgment smarter.
Slightly reduced the release power just before a Power Swing is triggered.

In Quick Match and Private Match, 60 seconds of practice time has been added after matching is complete and before the match starts.: If all players are filled within 60 seconds, a new match will start immediately.
New customization items and stamps have been added. The tiers of some items have been changed.: They can be obtained through beam drops in the demo.
We've added a new Ranking tab, where you can see your ranking in each category up to 50th place.
For your convenience, you can now view your quest list and friends list in-game via the ESC menu.
Added the ability to invite friends in Private Matches.

Beam points have been removed and replaced with MVP points.: You can earn MVP points by scoring, saving, passing, etc. in Quick Matches, and you can use them to earn Beam Drops.: You can earn up to three Beam Drops per week.
Added Match History and Replays categories in the Profile tab.
Added player Summary menu to view stats for other players, including yourself.
When you equip the Unbreakable Chain perk, the color and the effect of the chain change (yellow to purple).
Changed the goal effect at the rim when scoring: the effect is different in training and regular arenas.
1) In-game balancing to create multiple scoring ways
Slightly reduced the power of Back Dash.
Slightly increased the grab range.
Slightly reduced the air resistance applied to the ball.
Removed the air resistance applied to the character.
Slightly reduced basic nitro recovery rate.
2) Changes through feedback
The arrow pointing to the ball has been changed so that it does not appear when a ball is in sight.
Logic tweaked to allow the AI to be smarter in movement, shot, and pass decisions.
Added ball camera function.
The quick chat UI design has been improved.
After a team has scored, the push back is extended from the 3-point line to near the half court line.
3) Bug fixes
Fixed a bug where users were not properly visible in the private match waiting room.
Fixed a bug where team changes did not work when returning to the waiting room after playing a private match.

topNew: 1) In-game balancing to create multiple scoring ways
Slightly reduced the power of Back Dash.

items.text: 1) Balancing
When using Back Dash, it has been modified to move backward with more force than before.
The range of grabs has been slightly reduced.
Slightly increased repulsion when colliding with a ball while shielded.
Base chain length slightly reduced.
Slightly increased collision range between characters.
Increased AI logic and difficulty in Quick Match (Pro Bots). May be more difficult for beginners.
2) Gameplay changes
When releasing during a Swing Shot, it is difficult for beginners to get the timing right, so the Swing Shot Assist function has been added. It's now easier to time the release on Swing Shots.
An arrow has been added above the character's head to indicate the location of the ball when it is out of sight.
Characters are now affected by air resistance.
3) Bug fix
Fixed a bug that was causing players to load into different matches during private matches.

topNew: When using Back Dash, it has been modified to move backward with more force than before.
The range of grabs has been slightly reduced.

items.text: Fixed a bug where the camera would rotate 360 degrees when tilting or steering in the air.
A Tilt method selection has been added to the options.
A Swing Shot compensation function has been added to the options.
Fixed a bug where some eyebrows and eyelashes were not saved properly when saving after randomly changing appearance in Appearance.
Fixed a bug where your name or another user's name was displayed incorrectly when entering a Quick Match.
Added Power Swing training.
A more user-friendly interface has been added in relation to the tutorials and training courses.
Addition of a UI that displays the names of opponents and team members during matches.
Changes to chain and ball effects.
Fixed an odd animation that would occur when colliding with a dash tackle.
Changed the images on the game mode selection screen.

topNew: A more user-friendly interface has been added in relation to the tutorials and training courses.

items.text: 1) Fixed "Private Match" waiting room UI
Changed the icon UI representing the lobby owner and player.: 2) Bug fix
Fixed a bug where you could hang upside down from the map ceiling and hoop board.
Fixed a bug where the ball would move abnormally when you held it and went up the wall.

topNew: Changed the icon UI representing the lobby owner and player.: 2) Bug fix
Fixed a bug where you could hang upside down from the map ceiling and hoop board.

items.text: Hello Riders!

notes.title: A little patch after yesterday's feedback

items.text: --Update content
1) Added: "Very Low" graphics option
Parameters: can now change default camera Y, Z value
FOV widened when close to a wall
Fixed a bug where characters were not visible in the final scene after the match was over.
Fixed a bug where T-Pose came out when participating in a quick match.: Thank you for all your feedback! Please keep them coming!
Hello Riders!
Slightly increased basic character movement speed.
Side swing speed increased.
Slightly increased the power of the side swing when released.
Slightly increased the bounce of the ball when it hits the ground or walls.
Increased the power of regular dashes and jump dashes.
Reduced overall gravity slightly.: Please share your feedback about these changes in the DEMO LIVE FEEDBACK channels on our Discord!
